race.comment: Tricky little contest for the now three-year-olds. COVERT ACTION (4) made a nice impression winning on debut at Cranbourne, showing sustained speed to win well in good time. This is a step up but he can progress and give another bold sight. RUBARE (3) was off a freshen at Morphettville Parks last start but won well having been in good form in Melbourne prior. She's race fit, uncomplicated and should take beating again. REBEL TUESDAY (2) resumes. She won two in a row last time in, both in Adelaide including a narrow Listed win. Two trials have been inconclusive, watch the late betting. HEARTS AFFAIR (8) comes down from NSW for the Waterhouse & Bott yard off an easy win at Kembla Grange. Harder now but respecting the yard and natural upside. SUPERBEC (10) stuck on well enough on debut in a swooper's race, she can improve and run another good race.
